title: Produce the Italian Fibonacci Luna candidate
description: Implement only the Italian Fibonacci product under a Luna worker. Use a transaction-specific output area, preserve exact inputs and accounting returned by STARCHART, and do not inspect or modify the Sol candidate. Do not rebuild or modify STARCHART.
design:
Purpose: Implement the frozen Italian Fibonacci specification using the current Luna worker in an isolated transaction.
Preconditions: The SPEC digest is exact; the Sol candidate is unavailable to this worker; the accepted STARCHART release is unchanged.
Principal postcondition: A self-contained Luna candidate and reproducible verification outputs satisfy the frozen Italian Fibonacci SPEC without reading the Sol candidate.
Work kind: implementation
Build mode: none
Recipe:
acceptance_criteria: The program, tests, verifier output, artifact inventory, and limitations are returned durably; all deterministic SPEC checks pass or one concrete blocker is reported; transaction accounting is preserved without invented cost figures.
